name: Charles M. Tibbetts
role: Slaughter-house pipefitter, then night engineer and watchman
bio: Charles M. Tibbetts did piping and fitting work at the slaughter-house with Houlihan, praised in July 1885. In August 1885 he became night engineer and watchman there.

moments.label: Praised for pipefitting at the slaughter-house

mentions: Contractor McGee finishes the work on the slaughter-house to-day. The building is pronounced by those who should know as equal to any building of its kind in the United States.
There has been an immense amount of piping and fitting done at the slaughter-house and Messrs. Tibbetts and Houlihan have received many compliments for the superiority of their work.
Harry Barker takes Geo. Wilkes' place as engineer at the slaughter-house and Charles M. Tibbetts takes the positions of night engineer and watchman.
